references.text: The Levites were to take down the tabernacle when it was time to break camp, and set it up again when the camp was established.
The duties of the Gershonites concerning the tabernacle, its tent coverings, and the curtain.
The duty of the Merarites was to carry the tabernacle's boards, bars, pillars, and bases.
Detailed instructions regarding the service of the Gershonites in carrying the tabernacle.
Detailed instructions regarding the service of the Merarites in carrying the structure of the tabernacle.
Moses gave carts and oxen to the Gershonites and Merarites for transporting the tabernacle.
